source: postgres.pg_constraint CHECK + enum types on status/state columns

constraints.definition: CHECK (((status IS NULL) OR ((status)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('active'::character varying)::text, ('inactive'::character varying)::text, ('archived'::character varying)::text, ('success'::character varying)::text, ('failure'::character varying)::text, ('failed'::character varying)::text, ('error'::character varying)::text, ('pending'::character varying)::text, ('unknown'::character varying)::text]))))

CHECK (((elimination_status)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('unmatched'::character varying)::text, ('confirmed'::character varying)::text, ('eliminated'::character varying)::text, ('disputed'::character varying)::text])))

CHECK (((status IS NULL) OR ((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['active'::character varying, 'inactive'::character varying, 'archived'::character varying, 'processing'::character varying, 'completed'::character varying, 'failed'::character varying, 'rolled_back'::character varying])::text[]))))

CHECK (((status)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('draft'::character varying)::text, ('issued'::character varying)::text, ('paid'::character varying)::text, ('overdue'::character varying)::text, ('cancelled'::character varying)::text])))
CHECK (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['active'::character varying, 'expired'::character varying, 'terminated'::character varying, 'pending'::character varying])::text[]))) NOT VALID

CHECK (((status)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('planned'::character varying)::text, ('active'::character varying)::text, ('inactive'::character varying)::text, ('archived'::character varying)::text, ('completed'::character varying)::text, ('cancelled'::character varying)::text])))

CHECK (((status IS NULL) OR ((status)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('pending'::character varying)::text, ('in_progress'::character varying)::text, ('completed'::character varying)::text, ('cancelled'::character varying)::text, ('on_hold'::character varying)::text]))))
CHECK (((status IS NULL) OR ((status)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('active'::character varying)::text, ('inactive'::character varying)::text, ('archived'::character varying)::text]))))
